insights.title: User Authentication Workflow Detected

insights.title: High Frequency of Refresh Calls
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 22 times in a single test, suggesting potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the necessity of multiple refresh calls in the workflow.

insights.title: High Latency in Report Generation
insights.description: The POST /sfdemosite130/simsfinance.home endpoint recorded a p95 latency of 1988ms, which may affect user experience.
insights.recommendation: Analyze the performance of the endpoint to identify optimization opportunities.

executiveSummary:
• User authentication workflows are stable and consistently executed across tests. 
• High frequency of refresh calls may indicate inefficiencies in the budget management process. 
• Report generation times, particularly for the Trial Balance and Crystal Reports, show potential latency issues. 
• Investigating the necessity of multiple refresh calls could enhance performance. 
• Performance analysis of the report generation endpoints is recommended to improve user experience.
